title: SWE-Residual: Evaluating Starting-State Robustness of Coding Agents
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce SWE-Residual, a benchmark for Starting-State Robustness: the ability to maintain performance on a task when the starting state already contains earlier work on that task.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Software engineering (SWE) benchmarks are the primary way to measure the capabilities of coding agents: an agent is placed in a code repository or machine environment, given a request, and judged by hidden tests.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across five frontier agents, success drops by 20.6--53.5 percentage points on DeepSWE and 20.6--34.9 points on Terminal-Bench relative to a Clean Start, and agent rankings on DeepSWE reverse.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: SWE-Residual contains 198 Residual States drawn from 111 tasks in DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench, where the earlier work modifies a code repository or a whole machine environment.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
